name: STURDeCAM29

sources.title: STURDeCAM29 - 2MP OV2311 monochrome global shutter GMSL2 camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor (OmniVision OV2311), resolution (2MP, 1600 x 1300), shutter, focus, optical format, output Y10, pixel size, FOV with the standard lens, frame rate, interface, power, size, board weight, IP65

note: A monochrome global-shutter GMSL2 camera in an IP65 enclosure with integrated 940 nm IR LEDs synchronised to the sensor; S-mount lens, "Fixed focus, glued". FOV "131 x 93 x 74" degrees (D x H x V) "with standard lens". The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Stream: "2 MP @ 60 fps", Y10, with "Resolution: 2MP (1600 x 1300 pixels)" on the same page. power_w is the stated 1.7 W at 25 C (12 V supply). mass_g is the stated "Board weight" 131 g (the page gives no other mass). size_mm: the stated 52.52 mm (L) x 59.02 mm (W) x 42.75 mm (D), entered as [42.75, 59.02, 52.52] on the reading that D is along the optical axis (an assumption: the page names no axes). Not stated: f-number, focal length, distortion.
interface: GMSL2 (FAKRA connector, cable up to 15 m)

imagers.name: Mono
imagers.figures_conflict: The stated diagonal (131 deg) is wider than any centred, radially symmetric lens without pincushion distortion can show with the stated 93 x 74 deg across 1600 x 1300 px (at most about 117 deg); the diagonal may be the lens's rating for a larger image circle. The library uses the horizontal and vertical angles.
